key_findings: Sub-anaesthetic propofol prevented and reversed CPIP mechanical allodynia via PTEN activation, PI3K/AKT inhibition and reduced IL-6 in the spinal dorsal horn.
PTEN inhibitor bpV abolished propofol analgesia; signalling changes were mainly in neurons.
